spans.s:
बंहिष्ठ (ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
a. Much, many.

बंहीयस् (यान्-यसी-यः)
a. Idem.

बन् (द, उ, ङ) बनुते 8.
a. To ask or beg.

बन्ध् (ग,) बध्नाति 9.
a. (क) बन्धयति
10.
a. To bind or tie. With आ
to let loose; with अनु to follow,
be attached to; with नि to loos-
en; with सं to connect.

बन्ध (न्धः) 1.
m. A pledge, a depo-
site; a binding; the body.

बन्धक (कं) 1.
n. Exchanging, barter;
a city; confinement.
m. A pledge.
f. (की) A harlot; an elephant.

बन्ध-तन्त्र (न्त्रं) 1.
n. A complete army.

बन्धन (नं) 1.
n. Binding; rope for
tying cattle; killing.
m. n. f. A
rope, a chain, bandage, &c.

बन्धन-ग्रन्थि (न्थिः) 2.
m. Rope for tying
cattle; knot of a ligature.

बन्धन-रज्जु (ज्जुः) 2.
f. Idem.

बन्धन-वेश्मन् (श्म) 5.
n. A prison.

बन्धना-लय (यः) 1.
m. Idem.

बन्ध-स्तम्भ (म्भः) 1.
m. The post to
which an elephant is tied.

बन्धित्र (त्रं) 1.
n. Love, desire.

बन्धु (न्धुः) 2.
m. A kinsman; a friend.

बन्धुक (कः) 1.
m. A flower, a shrub
(Pentapetes phoenicea).

बन्धूक (कः) 1.
m. A shrub bearing a red
flower (Pentapetes phoenicea).

बन्धु-जन (नः) 1.
m. A friend.

बन्धु-जीव (वः) 1.
m. Pentapetes.

बन्धुता (ता) 1.
f. A multitude of
friends; friendship.

बन्धुत्व (त्वं) 1.
n. Friendship.

बन्धु-दत्त (त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
p. Given by friends.
n. Gifts to a girl at marriage.

बन्धुर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Uneven; bent;
pleasing; deaf; injurious.
m. A
goose; a flower (Pentapetes);
a bird; a crane; a drug.
f. A
whore.
n. A crest; dregs of oil
cake. (
pl.) Meal of parched corn.

बन्धूर (रः-रा-रं)
a. Wavy, undulating;
handsome.
m. A hole, a chasm.

बन्धु-हीन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Friendless.

बन्धूक-पुष्प (ष्पं) 1.
m. A tree (Pen-
taptera tomentosa).

बन्धूलि (लिः) 2.
m. Flower (Pentapetes).

बन्ध्य (न्ध्यः-न्ध्या-न्ध्यं)
a. Barren, child-
less; detained.
f. A perfume.

बान्धकिनेय (यः) 1.
m. A bastard.

बान्धव (वः) 1.
m. A relation, a friend.

बान्धवा_क्रोशिन् (शी-शिनी-शि)
a. Be-
wailing a friend or relation.
